note: Pre-generated with the Lampwarden pipeline (Opus via Mubit: generator, verifier, one fix, best-of), rendered in Vercel Sandbox. Rows with source "mubit" are what the scene draws: temple, house, wall, stall and the decorations were drawn with three candidates, one fix and best-of (their own scores are in the row). Rows with a `verified` block were scored again on 24 Oct 2026 with that day's verifier prompt (verifier_prompt_sha) and the live acceptance rule (verifier pass, or score >= 6 with no engine flags), with the Mubit request ids. cyclops and harpy were regenerated that day in a Vercel Sandbox (three to five candidates, best-of); satyr, olive, galley-dock, trireme and zeus-statue are earlier runs, scored again. zeus-statue is below the bar (5.5): three regeneration runs reached 6 at best but read worse in the scene, so the earlier sprite stays. The top-level score fields of a row are the score when it was generated, not today's. lamp-lit and lamp-unlit, and the temple-handwritten, house-handwritten, wall-handwritten and stall-handwritten fallbacks, are hand-written calls to the kit's building builders, not Mubit output; their `verified` block is a score only.
